entry_points.text: Range helper uses early direct path without host block else normalizes alignment and delegates chunks until covered.

exports.text: Cache WC/WT/WB helpers over start plus count and SNP shared/private/accept plus SVSM validate entry change caching or page state; SNP helpers no-op without SNP, SVSM retries large as small.
IO unmap releases validated ioremap areas after tracing and type release, warning on foreign or legacy addresses; phys-valid, phys-to-virt and boot-feature predicates gate large-page use.
Typed native and PV constructors plus setters for top and middle levels install, create and clear entries; disabled top level folds to next.

hazards.text: Size change needs global flush after split before attr change; 32-bit replicates across global list; PUD repair only warns; PV shared text/identity pages bypass text-RO when already small.
Unrecoverable validation warns then terminates via secure path; host exchange failure or missing block ends guest, AP failure returns error, unsupported forwarded vectors trap fatally.

invariants.text: Requests filter against text, text-RO, rodata and PCI-BIOS: XD for text/BIOS, WP for text-RO/rodata; overlap is closed-interval, VA bounds for text, frame bounds for BIOS/rodata, gated by flags, with distinct conflict reports.

Only 2M/1G handled with large-small-large conversion, caller masks, protnone fixup, clamped count; preserve when equal, split when partial or protection mismatch, EINVAL otherwise with forced repair on inconsistency; WX warns once on new W+X leaves except 32-bit, no-NX, non-leaves.

Split replicates frame plus normalized attrs per sub-page, 1G by medium stride, PV-notified, installed with kernel table prot, direct-map accounting updated, global flush; caller-top populate merges masks and unmaps only added range on failure.

Faults split caller-table populate, identity holes synthesizing one frame, silent highmap failures and warned failures; lookup uses caller top else kernel top, with counting and empty hooks for checked and preserved large pages.
Native ctors wrap raw values with top masking and folded nesting; clearing stores zero via setters; legacy 3-level top changes need caller invalidate via control reg.

Walk is coarse-to-fine with head/tail fixup, whole-large fast path, on-demand tables, extents/masks/slot counts; tables use init-mm plus kernel prot, free only when empty; large unions huge marker gated by length and CPU; child VA via mask; alias propagates with full flush; clear-only uses empty set.
Dispatcher picks monitor path when nested else direct insn, then evicts newly private pages unless fixed; one large equals 512 small; edge-byte touch mitigates incoherence.

Exceptions need valid flag plus GP/UD, high-half code optional; forwarder routes GP/UD/PF/AC with CR2 for PF else fatal; CR2 via PV or native; frames shift plus base; CA per-CPU else RIP boot page; flags via stack/CLI, restore only if IF.

VMSA uses monitor calls when nested else direct small-page adjust to lower level; PTE-enc prep inert, cleanup clears flag; copies are intrinsic, 32-bit word-byte and 64-bit byte forms; disabled builds trivialize validate/adjust/evict.

locks.text: Split lookup and install hold table spinlock; table alloc drops attr and optional init-mm read locks around alloc then reacquires.
Tracing holds IRQ-safe lock for search/unprobe/record; unregister holds IRQ-disable plus spinlock; GHCB and jump-table run IRQ-disabled, warn if enabled, invalidate on release.
SVSM validate plus call setup and page-state plus AP control use per-CPU area while IRQ-disabled to avoid migration, with nesting around GHCB acquire and restore after.

state_machines.text: GHCB moves inactive-active-backup with boot fallback, single nesting via backup, double nesting fatal, release restores or invalidates; discovery uses SNP path else invalidate-request-publish-exit-readback-release.
Fault pages count with armed plus once-queued flags; zero disarms and defers free past grace; disarm and alloc failures log and leave disarmed or leaked without retry.

Size-mismatch large entries retry as small over same span; PSC copies bounded, invokes host until progress passes end, failing on error info, reserved bits or regress; chunks allow large only when aligned, rescind before share, validate after private.

GHCB calls invalidate, set version/usage, clear aux, publish, reject pending, validate exceptions, translate codes; AP control combines CPU/level/event with addr and flags, checking validity and success.

structs.text: Trace record holds phys plus virt plus length plus op plus id; unmap emits fixed unprobe code with zero phys/len plus map id or missing marker.

PSC entries carry frame/op/size, monitor entries frame/bool/size, header current/end/reserved, inclusive without regress; private validates, shared rescinds; host blocks hold version/usage, exit code/info, buffer, regs; GHCB via MSR halves, jump via fixed exit codes.

SVSM core id encodes protocol zero high plus call low for validate and VCPU create/delete; validate uses F2 0F 01 FF and adjust F3 0F 01 FE with addr plus size plus request, plus distinct no-update condition.
